lines.text: David sang to the LORD when He delivered him from his enemies and Saul, calling Him his rock.
The cords of Sheol entangled David, so he cried out to the LORD, who heard from His temple.
The earth shook because the LORD burned with anger, and He mounted a chariot of fire and flew.
God trains David's hands for battle, and David says his arms can bend a bow of iron.
God delivered David from the strife of his people and kept him as head of nations, and foreigners obey him.
